new_rules.text: If the task’s reference to yearly temperature readings is taken to require a complete annual observation for every year from 2005 through 2015, the visible chart must show or otherwise identify a 2011 reading before completeness of that annual series can be established. The absence of an explicitly displayed 2011 point does not alter the visible 2005 and 2015 endpoint positions, but it leaves complete yearly coverage unverified.
